summary.tagline: Open waters and dramatic mountain vistas on Ireland's scenic northern lough.

travel.headline: Check Navigation and Mooring Policies on the Erne
travel.reservation: Access to the water is generally open, but those piloting vessels should consult Waterways Ireland for navigation guidelines. Mooring and specific club access, such as at Killadeas, may require local membership or site-specific fees that should be verified through official channels before arrival.

days.title: Dramatic Vistas and Open Waters

stops.name: Lower Lough Erne
stops.detail: Explore the more open and dramatic section of the system, which provides expansive views of the surrounding mountains. This area is a focal point for leisure and competitive sailing, particularly near the local yacht club.

days.driving: Allow time for local boat transfers or short lakeside drives; conditions vary by weather.
days.note: Wind conditions on the open lough can shift rapidly, impacting sailing and sightseeing visibility.

intel.title: Lakeside Access
intel.text: Specific parking availability at public jetties is not detailed in current evidence. Visitors should verify local parking capacity at Killadeas or other launch points before departure.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Cellular signal strength on the open waters of the lough is unconfirmed. Do not rely on digital maps for navigation across the water system.

intel.title: Vessel Refueling
intel.text: Evidence does not list specific fuel dock locations along the Lower Lough shore. Plan to secure necessary supplies in gateway towns like Killadeas.

intel.title: Sailing Events
intel.text: Competitive sailing is frequent on the lough. Check with the Lough Erne Yacht Club for scheduled events that may increase water traffic.

intel.title: Waterway Navigation
intel.text: The Lower Lough is more open than the Upper Lough, requiring different navigational awareness. Review Waterways Ireland charts for mountain-affected wind patterns.

plan.arrival: Arrive in the Killadeas area to check in at local accommodation or coordinate with the yacht club for water access.
plan.vehicle: Road access is suitable for standard cars; check for height or weight restrictions if towing a boat trailer.
plan.goldenHour: Mountain-view vistas from the eastern shore offer scenic sunset potential, subject to seasonal cloud cover.
